candidates.topic: The Judas Cradle — Torture Device That Was Never What You Think
candidates.teaser: The most feared torture device in history wasn't actually used the way anyone thinks — and the truth is somehow worse.
candidates.video_title: The Torture Device History Got Completely Wrong
candidates.video_description: The Judas Cradle is one of history's most infamous torture instruments — but almost everything you've heard about it is a myth. The real story is far darker than the legend. Historians are still debating whether it was even real.
candidates.script: The most feared torture device of the Middle Ages probably never worked the way you've been told — and historians aren't even sure most of them were ever used. The Judas Cradle, a pyramid-shaped seat, was said to slowly destroy its victims over hours. But every detailed account of it appears centuries after the Inquisition ended. So who invented the story — and why does the fabricated version keep spreading while the real methods stay buried?

candidates.topic: The Cicada 3301 Puzzle — Internet's Most Mysterious Recruitment
candidates.teaser: Someone posted a single image online in 2012 — and it started a puzzle so complex that governments might be behind it.
candidates.video_title: The Internet Puzzle Nobody Has Ever Fully Solved
candidates.video_description: In January 2012, an anonymous post appeared claiming to be recruiting 'highly intelligent individuals.' What followed was a multi-layered puzzle spanning dark web pages, physical locations across 12 countries, and ancient cryptographic texts. Nobody knows who runs Cicada 3301 — or why.
candidates.script: In 2012, a single black image appeared online with one sentence: 'We are looking for highly intelligent individuals.' What came next spanned the dark web, prime number theory, ancient Mayan numerology, and physical packages mailed to strangers in 12 different countries. The people who got furthest in the puzzle were never heard from again. Three separate recruitment cycles happened. No one has publicly claimed to have finished it — and no one knows who posted it.

candidates.topic: Ball Lightning — The Weather Phenomenon Science Cannot Explain
candidates.teaser: Thousands of people across history have reported seeing it — but science still cannot prove it exists.
candidates.video_title: A Weather Event Science Refuses to Explain
candidates.video_description: Ball lightning has been reported for centuries by sailors, pilots, soldiers, and ordinary people — glowing orbs that float through walls, last for minutes, and vanish without a trace. Despite thousands of witness accounts dating back to ancient Greece, no controlled scientific experiment has ever successfully reproduced it.
candidates.script: Nikola Tesla claimed he created it in his lab. A Russian physicist drove through it at 60 miles per hour. A British woman watched one float through her closed kitchen window, circle the room, and exit through a wall — leaving no trace. Ball lightning has been reported by thousands of credible witnesses since ancient Greece, yet in over 100 years of modern physics, not a single scientist has successfully reproduced it under controlled conditions. We still have no agreed explanation for what it actually is.

candidates.topic: The Ship of Theseus — Your Body Is Not the One You Were Born With
candidates.teaser: Every single atom in your body has been replaced since you were born — so are you actually the same person?
candidates.video_title: You Haven't Had the Same Body for Years
candidates.video_description: Almost every atom in the human body is replaced over time — some cells within days, others within years. Physicists and philosophers have argued for centuries about what this means for identity, memory, and consciousness. You are, in a very literal sense, a different physical object than you were ten years ago.
candidates.script: The skeleton inside you right now didn't exist ten years ago. Your stomach lining replaces itself every five days. Your red blood cells are gone within four months. Even most of your neurons swap out their internal components constantly. By the time you finish watching this, thousands of atoms that were 'you' will be exhaled, shed, or excreted — replaced by atoms that were somewhere else this morning. So when exactly did you stop being the person you were born as — and does that version of you still exist anywhere?

candidates.topic: Project MKUltra — The CIA Mind Control Program That Actually Happened
candidates.teaser: The U.S. government secretly dosed its own citizens with LSD for over a decade — and destroyed all the evidence.
candidates.video_title: The CIA Mind Control Program They Tried to Erase
candidates.video_description: Project MKUltra ran from 1953 to 1973, involving over 150 research projects across 80 institutions including universities and hospitals. The CIA dosed unwitting civilians, prisoners, and mental patients with LSD and other drugs. In 1973, Director Richard Helms ordered all files destroyed — but 20,000 documents survived a misfiling, exposing everything.
candidates.script: For 20 years, the CIA secretly dosed American and Canadian citizens with LSD without their knowledge — in hospitals, university labs, and prisons. The program, called MKUltra, ran 150 separate experiments across 80 institutions. Some subjects were drugged for 77 consecutive days. In 1973, the CIA director ordered every file shredded. They almost got away with it — until 20,000 documents were found misfiled in a records warehouse. The question no investigation ever answered: how many people never recovered?
